Accenture Federal Services is hiring a Mobile/TAK Developer to develop and maintain Android applications and plugins for ATAK and related TAK products. The role supports TAK integrations and situational awareness features while translating customer needs into production software.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain Android applications and plugins for the Android Team Awareness Kit (ATAK) and related TAK ecosystem products, under the guidance of senior developers
Assist in integrating Cursor-on-Target (CoT) messaging, mapping overlays, and situational awareness features into mobile applications
Write, test, and debug code supporting TAK Server API integrations
Interact with customers and end users to understand and help translate requirements into working software features
Have the ability to produce customer facing production code day one
Qualification

Required
1-3 years of experience in:
Native Android development in Java and/or Kotlin
Code source control such as GIT
Exposure to ATAK plugin development or the broader TAK ecosystem (TAK Server, CoT messaging, WinTAK/iTAK)
Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States
Preferred
Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL
Familiarity with geospatial/mapping concepts and symbology standards (e.g., MIL-STD-2525)
Use of static analysis, unit testing, and continuous integration
Handling more than 1 project concurrently
Experience working within AWS environments for development, testing, and integration
Experience working within a RHEL-based (Red Hat Enterprise Linux) development environment
Exposure to Windows desktop application development (e.g., C#/.NET, WPF) outside of WinTAK
Development with Python, Go, or other modern OOP languages
Working in a Linux environment with an understanding of agile development
Mobile/web application development and REST
Benefits
The selected candidate will work remotely as part of an existing team.
Hands-on experience, certifications, and industry training.
